medium: The implementation does not enforce the approved design's stated requirement to open all 7 observation cards before committing. Opening and marking only meal/fluid/urine enables sharing and confirmation while the 4 fixed cards remain unopened and progress remains 3/7.

Several source-level QA checks are semantically vacuous or materially narrower than their names. The immutable-mark check passes although markEvidence explicitly permits replacing an existing mark before confirmation; the Gate G observation check searches from the reflecting branch through EOF and could be satisfied by the playing branch; diagnosis/action checks cover only three literal phrases.

failure_codes.finding: The 7/7 observation requirement is informational only. allMarked depends solely on the three scored cards, and both sharing and confirmation can unlock at 3/7.

The harness reports that marks cannot be changed once made, but it only rejects resetting to null; markEvidence can overwrite true with false or vice versa. Its Gate G block extraction also extends through the playing branch, allowing a removed reflection observation rendering to pass.

recommended_actions: Require openedCount === 7 before enabling the share checkbox and confirmation, and add a harness assertion covering the 3/7 shortcut.
Replace the immutable-mark assertion with an accurately named test of post-commit immutability, or intentionally lock each mark after its first selection if that is the desired behavior.
Bound every branch-specific harness extraction at the next outcome/playing branch and assert the required expressions inside that exact block.
Use structural or broader child-facing-text checks for diagnosis, derived-action, and patient-improvement regressions instead of a three-phrase blacklist.
